A '''block of copper''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds [[Blast Furnace]] recipes and [[Crafting Table]] recipes for the 4 variants below, and otherwise leaves them as in vanilla. See {{MCW|Block of Copper}} for everything else.
